note: THE SUITE'S CELLS AND POINTS (rola_devtools.cells). `cells` are the attention reference's inputs (rola_bench.measure.cells:qkv); rola's cells are the target checkout's benchmarks/cells registries, referenced by name. A point groups cells by runner -- `rola` (rola's bench.provider) and `attention` (rola_bench.measure.attention) -- and states what it holds equal; `equal` names the parameters its cells must share. The carry points hold tokens and value width and name the RoLA state count; the layer points are rola's own.
